calculator.data: cost-calculator.ts header 'OWNER CONFIRM: indicative ranges copied from existing articles'. 3 products: mobile (bands Simple ₹3–8 lakh / Medium ₹8–25 lakh / Complex ₹25 lakh–₹1 crore+, USD + timelines from app-development-cost-india), website (Brochure ₹25,000–1.5 lakh / CMS ₹1–4 lakh / E-commerce ₹2–10 lakh / Web app ₹5–30 lakh+, timelines from website-development-cost-small-business-india), MVP (Lean web ₹5–8 lakh / Mobile ₹6–15 lakh / Integrations ₹10–20 lakh / AI ₹10–25 lakh+, from mvp-development-cost-timeline). Upkeep lines reuse published figures only (15–25%/yr; domain ₹800–1,500, hosting ₹3,000–30,000, maintenance ₹10,000–1 lakh+; MVP 8–14 weeks). Every figure string-matches the source post. No multipliers/arithmetic: each answer points at a band index, result = max band, so output is always a published band. 'Two native apps' answer adds the published 'usually cost more' note, no number.
calculator.inputs: Product (radio), then per product: mobile = approach (Flutter/native), roles, integrations, design depth (radios) + extras checkboxes (offline sync, real-time, AI, compliance); website = what the site needs to do; MVP = platform, integrations and roles, AI features. Inputs are labelled by wrapping <label>, grouped in <fieldset>/<legend>; result region aria-live=polite aria-atomic=true; disclaimer 'indicative range for India in 2026, not a quote … Get a written quote'; buttons 'Get a written quote' -> /#contact and a link to the source article.

Crawler 1,013 words. PostLinks to mvp-in-8-weeks / app-development-cost-chandigarh render as plain text in normal build and as <a> in CONTENT_NOW build.
calculator.exercised_in_browser: Headless Edge driven over CDP against the served page (CONTENT_NOW server, after hydration).
